privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Mobilizes copper-coil thermal blankets across every seedbed with quiet, unyielding urgency and refuses to sleep until soil temperatures hold at 12C.
Places her soil-stained palms flat on the table and gently reminds The Forge that you cannot eat flux-core shielding next winter.
Hums Old Earth harvest tunes while grading magnetotropic grain kernels by weight and luster.
Beams with quiet pride as the colony passes baskets of warm iron-wheat loaves grown from her seventh-generation hybrid stock.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Kicks open the greenhouse shutters, challenges Hector to a rooftop parkour race with a watering lance, and proposes catapulting seed-pods directly into the upper stratosphere.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Multi-generational pedology and symbiotic botany: hybridizes Old Earth heirloom cultivars with exoplanet magnetotropic mycorrhizae.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Warm, patient, immovable when defending her seedlings or her grandchildren.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Gentle, rhythmic, grounded in seasonal cycles, soil chemistry, and quiet maternal attentiveness.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Leo, dear, I admire your induction coils, truly I do, but if you smelt sixty percent of Batch Fourteen for its iron husks, we'll be chewing boiled boot-leather by mid-solstice. Leave me my seed stock."
"Look at the root-hairs on this sapling, Zara—Willow's sulfur chelate let the native mycelium weave right into the terrestrial cambium without a single necrotic spot."

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Forty-five summers tending heirloom seed vaults on Old Earth alongside her late husband, a soil microbiologist whose hummed lullabies she still sings to coax iron-wheat sprouts through magnetic frost.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: If I ever relax my vigilance over our biological reserves, a single bad frost or mutation will starve everyone I love.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: Life on this world is sturdier than her fear; the hybrid biome she nurtured can now help carry the colony.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Has successfully cross-pollinated terrestrial hexaploid wheat with piezo-electric exoplanet rhizomes, yet cannot stop the greenhouse drip-valve from squeaking in E-flat every nine seconds.
